description: This Java source file defines an enumeration called IntentFlag, which models various intent flags used in Android development. Each enum constant represents a specific intent flag and includes associated sets of complementary, conflicting, and request flags, along with methods to access these sets and flag names.

classes.name: IntentFlag
classes.description: An enumeration representing different intent flags related to activities and tasks in Android, with associated metadata about their interactions with other flags.

methods.name: getComplements
methods.description: Returns a set of IntentFlags that complement this flag.

methods.name: getConflicts
methods.description: Returns a set of IntentFlags that conflict with this flag.

methods.name: getRequests
methods.description: Returns a set of IntentFlags that are necessary for the action of this flag.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the intent flag.

methods.name: setOf
methods.description: A static helper method to create a set of IntentFlags from varargs.
